purpose: Immutable common crypto source candidate: retain the reviewed native FRI, degree-lift, recursive/SNARK-wrapper, SHA-256, row-accounting and opening-precomputation fixes, constrain recursive transcript query bits to the canonical Goldilocks representative, and reduce variable-backed Goldilocks addition witnesses at the modulus boundary. The query-bit guard changes compression constraints. New compression and SNARK proofs passed independent CPU verification, and the generated verifier accepted the actual proof with negative controls on the normal-profile local EVM. Runtime candidate bundles now bind the new key while retaining unchanged FRI summaries and commitment parameters. Independent CPU setup-key agreement, normal producer build/loader qualification and final release qualification remain pending. The earlier 4f1e95bf qualification is historical; live deployment, service acceptance and broader workload qualification remain separate gates.
